en.title: Add-ons & Upgrade Packages
en.excerpt: Guidance on when to use add-ons, use cases, and gradual upgrade strategies.
en.content:
What is an Add-on?

Add-ons are capacity expansions or additional features on top of the main package.

When are Add-ons Needed?

  • When the number of participants/events exceeds the normal load of the package.
  • When special features are needed for a certain competition period.
  • When the organization wants to scale-up without switching packages. permanent.

Gradual Upgrade Strategy

Start with the core package, monitor usage, then activate add-ons as they approach operational limits to maintain cost efficiency.
